target_customer: Knowledge workers and professionals in meetings who want an AI notepad that completes their todos; earlier an open source meeting notetaker for privacy conscious users
problem: Meeting notes and todos pile up and cloud notetakers raise privacy concerns; users want an agent that does the work.
business_model: Free open source core with planned paid plans for self hosted admin features and business licenses (stated at the Launch HN); the Char app is in private beta with no public pricing
product_category: AI notepad and meeting notetaker, open source, local first

founders.name: John Jeong
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: designs interfaces for humans and agents. Listed as the active founder.

founders.name: Yujong Lee
founders.background_notes: YC page lists as a former founder and open source enthusiast.

founders.name: Deokhaeng Lee
founders.background_notes: YC page lists as a former founder.

competitors.name: Granola
competitors.what: AI meeting notepad; the Launch HN pitch described Hyprnote as an open source Granola

technical_complexity.rationale: On device transcription and summarization in a desktop app with bring your own key options is standard engineering with some hard local model work.

defensibility.rationale: Open source code can be forked and meeting notetakers are crowded; community and trust in privacy are the main assets.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established notetakers existed at the batch. No evidence found of Char being copied or bought.

market_need_then: Meeting notetakers were a popular category in 2025 and privacy concerns about bots and cloud APIs motivated the on device approach. A third party page cites over 7,000 GitHub stars, unverified.

branding.name_origin: Hyprnote was renamed to Char; the founders described the rename as building for a long time. Reasons not captured from the post.
branding.domain_note: The company now uses char.com; the earlier name used hyprnote.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual, direct and playful, lowercase accents, phrases like apple notes on steroids

rebrands.why: Not captured; the company posted that Hyprnote is now Char
A blog post says the open source notetaker is renamed Anarlog and relicensed MIT while Char becomes the todo productivity app

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN thread for Hyprnote in July 2025 and an open source community on GitHub

brand_strength.rationale: Two renames in a short period and a common word name dilute recognition, though open source community attention helped early awareness.

pivots.from: Hyprnote, open source on device AI meeting notetaker
pivots.to: Char, AI notepad that finishes todos with agents; the notetaker spun out as Anarlog
pivots.why: The company says Char is not a meeting notetaker and now focuses on agents completing todos

outcome_analysis: The company entered YC in Summer 2025 as Hyprnote, an open source on device meeting notetaker, renamed to Char and then repositioned around an AI notepad that completes todos while the open source notetaker became Anarlog. No funding or exit evidence is public, and two founders are listed as former, so the outcome is unresolved.
notes: I could not fetch the rename blog post (404 on the first URL tried); rename details come from search results. Funding: no reliable record; a VCBacked Char seed is a different restaurant company and an Altss entry lists unnamed family office investors only, so none recorded. The legal entity is Fastrepl, Inc. per the site. Dates for the renames are unknown. YC page says team size 4 while the directory says 3. Founded year 2023 per YC page.
